name: external-agent
description: Delegate to another coding agent (Codex by default; Gemini CLI, Ollama or LM Studio models, or Claude Code) from Claude Code, sharing the same conversation: /agent, /agent-review, and a tool Claude can call like a sub-agent.

apiKey.title: API key (only for the API connection)
apiKey.description: Used only when the External Agent is set to connect through its API (off by default). Kept in secure storage. Agents on this machine never need it.
